By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] [[Unidentified survey team|survey team]] discovered an ancient '''Sith oubliette''' on<ref name="The Forgotten Prison" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="planet">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050609a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 5: Two Peas in a Pod}}</ref> [[Dromund Fels]].<ref name="The Forgotten Prison" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], an individual associated with the Empire sent a companion of theirs to explore the [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact's]] catacombs. Avoiding traps, the companion discovered the [[Prison/Legends|preserved]] body of a [[Unidentified prisoner (Dromund Fels)|prisoner]] in a treasure-filled room within the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] oubliette.<ref name="The Forgotten Prison" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith oubliette was mentioned in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the Crew Skill mission "The Forgotten Prison."<ref name="The Forgotten Prison" />
